title: Immunoperoxidase Histology and Densitometric Quantification for Tyrosine Hydroxylase
author: Roberta Marongiu
materials: Utilize IP Lab software for consistent digital acquisition.

steps.title: Select tissue sections
steps.instruction: Choose one substantia nigra (SN) and one striatal section from each animal for processing.

steps.title: Pool and code sections
steps.instruction: Place all selected sections from every experimental group into a single container and punch‑code the cortex of each section for later identification.

steps.title: Rinse sections in buffers
steps.instruction: Wash sections sequentially in 0.1 M phosphate buffer (PB) then in 0.1 M Tris‑saline (TS) while shaking at 90 rpm.

steps.title: Block non‑specific binding
steps.instruction: Incubate sections in 0.5 % bovine serum albumin (BSA) prepared in TS for 30 min with shaking at 90 rpm.

steps.title: Primary antibody incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate sections in sheep anti‑tyrosine hydroxylase (anti‑TH) antibody diluted 1:5000 in a solution of 0.1 % Triton‑X, 0.1 % BSA, and TS.

substeps.instruction: Option A: Incubate for 24 h at room temperature while shaking at 145 rpm.
Option B: Incubate for 24 h at 4 °C while shaking at 145 rpm.

steps.title: Rinse before secondary
steps.instruction: Rinse sections in TS (90 rpm) to remove unbound primary antibody.

steps.title: Secondary antibody incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate sections in biotin‑conjugated donkey anti‑sheep IgG diluted 1:400 in 0.1 % BSA/TS solution.

steps.title: Rinse before ABC
steps.instruction: Rinse sections in TS (90 rpm) to remove excess secondary antibody.

steps.title: ABC complex incubation
steps.instruction: Wash sections in TS, then incubate in avidin‑biotin complex (ABC) prepared at 50 % of the manufacturer’s recommended dilution for 30 min with shaking at 90 rpm.

steps.title: DAB chromogen reaction
steps.instruction: Develop peroxidase activity by immersing sections in 3,3′‑diaminobenzidine (DAB) solution containing 0.003 % H₂O₂ in TS for 10 min.

steps.title: Dehydrate through alcohol series
steps.instruction: Pass slides sequentially through ascending concentrations of ethanol (≈70 %, 95 %, then 100 %).

steps.title: Clear and coverslip
steps.instruction: Clear slides in xylene and apply coverslips using DPX mounting medium.

steps.title: Mount sections on slides
steps.instruction: Mount sections in 0.05 M phosphate buffer (PB) onto gelatin‑coated glass slides.

steps.title: Capture images
steps.instruction: Using a Nikon Eclipse 80i microscope equipped with a Micropublisher 5.0 camera, acquire images of the stained sections.

steps.title: Blind image acquisition
steps.instruction: Ensure the investigator acquiring images is blinded to the experimental conditions.

steps.title: Open images in ImageJ
steps.instruction: Load the captured images into ImageJ64 software.

steps.title: Convert pixel density
steps.instruction: Convert pixel density values to transmittance values for quantitative analysis.

steps.title: Define regions of interest
steps.instruction: Manually delineate regions of interest (ROIs) within the striatal areas for densitometric measurement.
